about: Events in lisboa: each exactly as first listed by its organiser's page (first: name, dates, venue, and the read that first saw it), never overwritten; every later change seen (changes: field, from, to, at); last_seen; gone_at when it stopped being listed before its date. Events read every 6 hours, so a change is dated by the read that first saw it. Claims: what Perplexity (through OpenRouter) said would happen, kept as answered with its evidence links and the time asked, to be checked when the date comes. Not confirmed listings.
